title: Efficacy and safety of a noninvasive, home-based radiofrequency device for facial rejuvenation: An open-label, intraindividual controlled trial
capture_type: Original research extraction; publisher full text consulted, no publisher full-text copy redistributed because redistribution license not established

hardware.temperature: Surface sensor; numeric cutoff not specified
hardware.power_limit: Reported settings; no independent load-specific absorbed-power validation

design.population: Women age 25–55 in results; Fitzpatrick III–IV
design.regimen: Grid-mask deep mode followed by gel daily mode, three times per week

results: Wrinkle scores and ultrasound thickness improved relative to baseline; image results mixed. Thickness is not collagen biopsy. No Thermage comparator.
safety: One transient erythema; no serious adverse event reported in small short cohort
commercial_support: Accompany Tech supplied devices and supported Rapid Service Fee
limitations: Combination protocol with proprietary mask and gel
